card.architecture: Flux.2 rectified-flow DiT (Qwen3 encoder), non-distilled base, whole-image img2img redraw
card.summary: Reinterpret an entire existing image through FLUX.2-Klein 4B using a prompt — the source is used as the init latent and re-sampled at a partial denoise with NO mask, so the composition is kept but the whole frame is redrawn in Klein's modern, realistic look. The NON-distilled base (bf16) on 24 GB: 20 steps at real CFG 5 with working negative prompts, higher fidelity than the 4-step distilled weight.
card.pick_when: You want a cheap, fast whole-image redraw on a commercially-usable FLUX.2 model.

prompt.guidance: Long/complex prose is handled well by the Qwen3 encoder. Lower the redraw strength to stay close to the source composition; raise it to let Klein reinterpret more.
prompt.example: A cozy reading nook by a rain-streaked window, a tabby cat asleep on a stack of books, warm lamplight, autumn leaves outside, soft painterly style
prompt.instructions:
Type the FULL description of the picture you want — this is a whole-frame re-render, not an edit instruction, and FLUX.2-Klein 4B follows natural-language prose.
20 steps, euler with the resolution-aware FLUX.2 schedule, real CFG 5 on the non-distilled base (no distilled-guidance knob).
'Redraw strength' (denoise) controls how far the result drifts from the source: ~0.3-0.5 keeps the source's structure and mostly restyles it, ~0.7+ substantially reinvents it.
The source is normalized to the configured ~1 MP working budget with its aspect ratio preserved, so low-resolution inputs gain a larger VAE grid and oversized inputs are reduced before sampling.
Negative prompts DO apply here — this variant samples at real CFG.

negative.note: Real CFG 5 on the non-distilled base; negatives work.

ui_help.note: Send an image + a description; the whole frame is redrawn through FLUX.2-Klein 4B. 'Redraw strength' controls how far it drifts from the source.
ui_help.good_for: a fast, cheap whole-image redraw keeping the composition

edit_use_cases: whole-image img2img: fast redraw of an entire image through FLUX.2-Klein 4B, keeping composition
